A1 one primitive adjacency edge per turn
A3 sampling-free target runtime; no source circle/Q, Euclidean distance, pi, sqrt, float, trig, word/boundary table or radius tuning

axiom_versions.A0_7_plus_monotone: Add first-sector a nonincreasing, b nondecreasing, Motzkin nonnegative/single-peak typing. Still nonunique.
axiom_versions.A0_7_plus_AG_count: Additionally require #1=#3=J_N(r), #2=r-J_N(r), hence the accepted sector/full period. Still nonunique.
axiom_versions.FINAL_ADM_E: A0-A7 plus A8 Primitive-Support Frontier Maximality. The support carrier is constructed independently from target D6 lattice incidence: primitive D6-invariant quadratic support index -> elementary-triangle barycentric support rank -> incident-edge two-triangle vertex support rank -> radius-r anchor support sublevel carrier. An admissible sector path is the oriented outer monotone frontier of this carrier. The axiom does not contain the N word, N residual sign sequence, or N turn table.

A8.name: PRIMITIVE_SUPPORT_FRONTIER_MAXIMALITY
A8.support_index_typing: incidence/support ordering only; explicitly not ENTERPRISE_LENGTH and not Euclidean distance
construction: Q_E is the primitive integral quadratic form invariant under R(a,b)=(-b,a+b), normalized Q_E(1,0)=1; D6 invariance uniquely yields Q_E(a,b)=a^2+ab+b^2.
For an elementary triangle t with vertices v1,v2,v3, define c(t)=v1+v2+v3 and triangle_support_rank(t)=Q_E(c(t)).
For a primitive edge e incident to vertex p with adjacent elementary triangles t+,t-, define edge_pair_rank(e)=max(rank(t+),rank(t-)).
Define vertex_support_rank(p)=min over primitive incident edges e of edge_pair_rank(e).
Define the radius-r primitive-support carrier K_E(r)={p: vertex_support_rank(p)<=Q_E(3r,0)=9r^2}.

The canonical sector path is required to be the outer monotone frontier of K_E(r), choosing the outward candidate whenever it remains in K_E(r), with the bisector move fixed by D6/reflection compatibility.
A8.runtime_dependency: A8 is a structural admissibility theorem/selection principle; the accepted AK tau keeps its residual recurrence and does not evaluate Q_E/support_rank at runtime.
A8.proof_side_coordinate_certificate: AG implies in the first sector vertex_support_rank(a,b)=9*(a^2+ab+b^2)-9*max(a,b)+3. This identity certifies the abstract target carrier and is not a source metric definition.

strengthening_reasons: A0-A7 admit the pure-axis hexagon resolver for every r.
Monotone/single-peak typing still admits the same hexagon and many bulged Motzkin cycles.
Even the exact AG J/period count does not determine the internal word arrangement; a packed-count resolver differs from N at r=5.
A8 is the first tested non-tautological target principle that removes both underdeterminations by selecting the unique outer support frontier.
